stories.headline: Trump Launches 'Project Freedom' to Escort Ships From Strait of Hormuz as Iran Sends 14-Point Plan

key_facts.fact: Trump announced 'Project Freedom' starting Monday to help stranded ships leave the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a humanitarian gesture for 'neutral and innocent' countries
key_facts.excerpt: Trump said 'Project Freedom' would begin Monday morning in the Middle East. Trump added that his representatives are having discussions with Iran that could lead to something 'very positive for all.'

key_facts.fact: Iran sent a 14-point counterproposal via Pakistan calling for nonaggression guarantees, sanctions relief, lifting the naval blockade, and ending the war 'on all fronts' including Lebanon
key_facts.excerpt: Tehran has sent a 14-point plan to Washington, calling for guarantees of nonaggression, sanctions relief, the lifting of a naval blockade and an end to the war 'on all fronts', including in Lebanon.

key_facts.fact: Trump expressed doubt the proposal would be acceptable, saying Iran 'has not yet paid a big enough price for what they have done to humanity, and the world, over the last 47 years'
key_facts.excerpt: Trump on Saturday said he was reviewing the proposal but expressed doubt it would lead to a deal, saying on social media that 'they have not yet paid a big enough price for what they have done to Humanity, and the World, over the last 47 years.'

key_facts.fact: The IRGC Navy likely attacked a vessel 11 nautical miles west of Sirik on May 3, the latest in at least two dozen attacks since the war began
key_facts.excerpt: UKMTO reported that multiple small craft attacked a vessel—likely the Liberian-flagged, Greek-owned Minoan Falcon—11 nautical miles west of Sirik, Hormozgan Province, Iran.

key_facts.fact: The IRGC said it is on standby for a return to war, saying a resumption of hostilities is 'likely' as evidence shows the US 'is not committed to any agreements or treaties'
key_facts.excerpt: The IRGC said it is on standby for a return to war with the US, saying a resumption of hostilities is 'likely' as 'evidence shows that [the US] is not committed to any agreements or treaties'.

key_facts.fact: Iran's proposal includes a three-phase plan: end the war within 30 days in Phase 1, delay nuclear talks to Phase 2, with Iran offering to discuss pausing uranium enrichment for up to 15 years
key_facts.excerpt: Al Jazeera reported that Iran offered to 'discuss the idea' of pausing uranium enrichment for 'up to 15 years,' which is longer than previous Iranian proposals to pause enrichment for up to five years.

stories.headline: OPEC+ Agrees to Raise June Oil Output by 188,000 Barrels per Day After UAE Exit

key_facts.fact: Seven OPEC+ countries — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman — agreed on May 3 to increase production by 188,000 barrels per day in June
key_facts.excerpt: OPEC said in a communique on Sunday that seven OPEC+ countries decided to increase their oil production cap by 188,000 barrels per day in June, in response to the withdrawal of the United Arab Emirates from the bloc.

key_facts.fact: June output quotas set at 10.291M bpd for Saudi Arabia and 9.762M bpd for Russia, not including compensation for overproduction
key_facts.excerpt: June output quotas will stand at 9.762 mln bpd for Russia, at 10.291 mln bpd for Saudi Arabia, at 4.352 mln bpd for Iraq, at 2.628 mln bpd for Kuwait.

key_facts.fact: The increase aims to accelerate compensation for overproduction since January 2024, following the UAE's withdrawal from OPEC+
key_facts.excerpt: This measure will provide an opportunity for the participating countries to accelerate their compensation. They also confirmed their intention to fully compensate for any overproduced volume since January 2024.

key_facts.fact: US national average gas price hit $4.45/gallon, up from $2.98 before the Iran war began, after surging ~30 cents in the prior week
key_facts.excerpt: The national average price for a gallon of gas was $4.45 as of Sunday, according to AAA. That's up from $2.98 right before the war in Iran began, with AAA reporting a few days ago that gas prices shot up nearly 30 cents in the previous week.

key_facts.fact: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said oil prices could start declining within 3 to 9 months, citing the UAE's OPEC exit and oil tankers stranded in the Gulf
key_facts.excerpt: The UAE has decided that OPEC is not for them. Most monopolies eventually collapse under their own weight. This gives me a lot of optimism that oil prices on the other side of this conflict are going to be much lower.

stories.headline: Ukraine Strikes Russia's Primorsk Port, Sinks Missile Ship, and Hits 3 Shadow Fleet Oil Tankers

key_facts.fact: Ukraine struck a Karakurt-class missile ship (equipped with Kalibr cruise missile launchers and 8 missiles with 2,000 km range), a patrol boat, and a shadow fleet tanker at Primorsk port on May 3
key_facts.excerpt: Zelensky reported on May 3 that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Karakurt-class small missile ship, a Russian patrol boat, and a Russian shadow fleet oil tanker near the port of Primorsk, Leningrad Oblast.

key_facts.fact: Two more shadow fleet tankers were hit near the entrance to Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiysk using unmanned surface vessels
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy said that Ukrainian forces had struck two more 'shadow fleet' tankers near the entrance of the Russian Black Sea port of Novorossiysk on Sunday.

key_facts.fact: Primorsk, Russia's largest oil exporting port on the Baltic Sea, lies over 1,000 km from Ukraine between the Russian-Finnish border and St. Petersburg
key_facts.excerpt: The port, operated by Russia's state oil firm Transneft, is capable of handling hundreds of thousands of barrels per day. Primorsk lies over 1,000 kilometres from Ukraine.

key_facts.fact: Satellite imagery shows Ukraine's late-April strikes on the Transeft Perm dispatch station burned ~70% of the facility and destroyed all 50,000 cubic meter tanks, halting operations
key_facts.excerpt: Satellite imagery captured on May 3 indicates that Ukraine's April 28 to 29 and April 30 to May 1 strikes against the Transeft Perm Linear Production Dispatch Station burned roughly 70 percent of the station, destroyed all the tanks with a 50,000 cubic meter capacity.

key_facts.fact: Russia deployed a record 6,583 long-range drones in April, surpassing March's previous high, averaging over 200 per day
key_facts.excerpt: Russia fired a record number of long-range attack drones at Ukraine – an average of more than 200 a day – according to AFP analysis.

key_facts.fact: Zelenskyy said Russia has lost at least $7 billion this year from attacks on its oil sector, with exports from Ust-Luga and Primorsk declining
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy stated on Friday that Russia has lost at least $7 billion since the start of the year due to attacks on its oil sector, adding that exports from key ports such as Ust-Luga and Primorsk have declined.

stories.headline: GameStop Makes Unsolicited ~$56B Offer to Buy eBay, Cohen Ready to Go Hostile

key_facts.fact: GameStop proposed on Sunday to buy eBay for ~$56B at $125/share in a 50-50 cash-and-stock deal, a 20% premium to eBay's Friday close
key_facts.excerpt: GameStop proposed on Sunday to buy eBay Inc for about $56 billion in a cash-and-stock deal. GameStop is offering to pay $125 a share in a 50-50 mix of cash and stock. Based on eBay's Friday close, the bid represents a premium of about 20%.

key_facts.fact: GameStop has built a ~5% stake in eBay and secured a $20B commitment letter from TD Bank for debt financing
key_facts.excerpt: Cohen said he has already lined up financial commitments, including a commitment letter for about $20 billion in debt from TD Securities. The U.S. videogame retailer has already built up a 5% stake in eBay.

key_facts.fact: GameStop had ~$9.4B in cash as of January 31; the company's market cap was ~$12B vs eBay's ~$46B, making it a dramatic reverse-scale acquisition
key_facts.excerpt: GameStop had about $9.4 billion in cash and liquid investments as of January 31. GameStop had a market value of nearly $12 billion at the close of business on Friday, while eBay had a market value of about $46 billion.

key_facts.fact: Cohen said he would pursue a proxy fight if eBay's board is unreceptive, and aims to cut $2B of eBay's annualized costs within 12 months
key_facts.excerpt: Cohen said in the letter that GameStop would cut $2 billion of eBay's annualized costs within 12 months of close. He told the Wall Street Journal he was prepared to pursue a proxy fight.

key_facts.fact: Cohen told WSJ he wants to make eBay 'a legit competitor to Amazon' and is 'thinking about turning eBay into something worth hundreds of billions of dollars'
key_facts.excerpt: 'It could be a legit competitor to Amazon,' Cohen said about eBay. 'I'm thinking about turning eBay into something worth hundreds of billions of dollars.'

stories.headline: Cerebras Targets Up to $26.6B Valuation in IPO, Roadshow Starts Monday

key_facts.fact: Cerebras is scheduled to kick off its IPO roadshow on Monday, selling 28 million shares at $115 to $125 apiece on Nasdaq under ticker 'CBRS'
key_facts.excerpt: AI chipmaker Cerebras Systems is scheduled to kick off its IPO roadshow on Monday, with shares expected to be priced between $115 and $125. The company now aims to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol 'CBRS'.

key_facts.fact: This is Cerebras' second attempt to go public after withdrawing a previous IPO filing in October
key_facts.excerpt: This marks Cerebras' second attempt to go public after withdrawing a previous IPO filing last October.

key_facts.fact: Revenue rose to $510M from $290.3M year-on-year, with a profit of $1.38/share — a turnaround from a loss of $9.90/share the prior year
key_facts.excerpt: The company's revenue rose to $510 million in the year ended December 31, up from $290.3 million a year earlier. It also reported a profit of $1.38 per share, a turnaround from a loss of $9.90 per share a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Barclays, and UBS are lead underwriters for the offering
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Barclays and UBS are the lead underwriters for the offering.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Says China AI Accelerator Market Share Has 'Dropped to Zero,' Calls Export Policy Backfire

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang told the Special Competitive Studies Project (SCSP) that Nvidia's market share of AI accelerators in China has 'now dropped to zero'
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that the company's market share of AI accelerators in China has now dropped to 0%.

key_facts.fact: Huang said US export policy 'has already largely backfired' and called for policy to be 'dynamically adjusted'
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen says US export policy 'has already largely backfired.'

key_facts.fact: An estimated $1 billion worth of Nvidia chips are being smuggled into China per quarter
key_facts.excerpt: Some estimates are that a billion dollars worth of Nvidia chips are being smuggled into China per quarter.

key_facts.fact: Bernstein had projected Nvidia's China AI chip market share would fall from 66% in 2024 to ~8% in 2026, but Huang says the actual decline is steeper
key_facts.excerpt: Bernstein had previously predicted Nvidia's China AI GPU market share could drop from 66% in 2024 to around 8% in coming years, but according to Huang, the decline is more drastic than expected.

key_facts.fact: Huang argued it is strategically unsound to abandon a market as large as China and said keeping US chip companies in that market 'is very meaningful'
key_facts.excerpt: Huang stated: 'Abandoning an entire market as large as China may not be strategically sound, so I believe this has largely backfired. I think policy needs to be dynamically adjusted.'

stories.headline: China's Linkerbot Raises Series B+ at $3B Valuation, Holds 80%+ of Global Dexterous Robot Hands Market

key_facts.fact: Linkerbot completed a Series B+ round valued at $3B and is targeting a $6B valuation in its next financing round
key_facts.excerpt: Beijing-based Linkerbot completed what it called a 'series B+' funding round last week that valued it at $3 billion. It will seek a $6 billion valuation in its next financing round.

key_facts.fact: Linkerbot holds over 80% of the global market share in high-degree-of-freedom dexterous robotic hands for humanoids
key_facts.excerpt: Linkerbot currently holds over 80% of the global market share in high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic hands.

key_facts.fact: The two-year-old unicorn plans to scale production from ~5,000 units/month to 10,000 units/month
key_facts.excerpt: Linkerbot plans to scale production 'soon' to 10,000 units a month from almost 5,000 currently, CEO Alex Zhou told Reuters.

key_facts.fact: Early backers include Alibaba's Ant Group and Sequoia spinoff HongShan; latest round drew Zhongguancun Science Park Fund, Bank of China Asset Management, and Fosun Capital
key_facts.excerpt: Early backers include Ant Group, the financial-services arm of Alibaba, and HongShan Group, the Chinese spin-out of Sequoia Capital. The latest round added the state-backed Zhongguancun Science Park Fund, Bank of China Asset Management, and Fosun Capital.

key_facts.fact: Investor interest in China's humanoid robotics has surged after Unitree's TV performance and Beijing robot half-marathon; Unitree filed for a Shanghai IPO in March seeking up to $7B valuation
key_facts.excerpt: Investor interest in China's humanoid robotics industry has surged this year after market leaders such as Unitree demonstrated their products' staggering technical advances. Unitree filed for a Shanghai IPO in March, seeking a valuation of up to $7 billion.
